# Refreshed with scripts/ci-test-weights from CI runs 44004378701 (dc3e50cf)
# and 44047684053 (62000413) on main. Each observed row is ceil(the slower

# their old weight; one-second rows use the partitioner's default. Every live
# test remains selected once.

# 3911 s to 3547 s and from 5294 s to 4437 s. These are offline sums of
# measured per-test times, not new live wall times. Live CI confirms the
# balance. Ten x86 shards, two aarch64 shards, four workers and all deadlines
# stay unchanged.
